title: Ball-Lalo Smart Inventory and Order Management System with AI Chatbot
description: A smart inventory and order management system with an AI chatbot assistant.

title: Sassy Strands Inventory & Production Tracker
description: One web app that replaces the client's Excel workbooks for inventory, client orders and production tracking.

caseStudy.problem: The client tracked bundle and closure inventory, available stock and client orders across several Excel workbooks. The goal was a single system for stock, orders and production, with access controlled by role.

features.title: Inventory and stock movements
features.description: Stock movements and running balances for bundles and closures, with pricing.

features.title: Client order monitoring
features.description: Track client orders and their OR numbers in one place.

features.title: Production stages and QA
features.description: Follow each order through production stages and quality assurance.

features.title: Spreadsheet import
features.description: Imports the client's existing workbooks and flags every row it cannot read cleanly.

features.title: Role-based access
features.description: Owner, Admin, Inventory, Production and QA roles enforced in the database with row-level security.

features.title: Reports
features.description: Reports built from the live inventory and order data.
